task: Path glob matcher with ?, *, **, **/, character classes and escapes, memoised matching
reasoning_summary: Parsed the pattern once into tokens (literal, ?, *, **, **/, class) and matched them with memoised recursion over (token, position), so pathological patterns stay polynomial. Tests combine a table of literal cases, a timing test, error cases and a randomized cross-check against java.util.regex. The only failure was a defect in the test's reference regex translation, fixed on attempt 2.
